List the first and last names of Physics majors.
gold_sql: SELECT first_name, last_name FROM students WHERE major = 'Physics'

question: List the first and last names of students who enrolled after 2021.
gold_sql: SELECT first_name, last_name FROM students WHERE enrollment_year > 2021

question: List departments whose average student grade exceeds 80.
gold_sql: SELECT c.department, AVG(g.numeric_score) FROM courses c JOIN enrollments e ON c.course_id = e.course_id JOIN grades g ON e.enrollment_id = g.enrollment_id GROUP BY c.department HAVING AVG(g.numeric_score) > 80

question: List the emails of students who have never enrolled in any course.
gold_sql: SELECT email FROM students WHERE student_id NOT IN (SELECT student_id FROM enrollments)

question: Find the first and last names of students who never enrolled in any course.
gold_sql: SELECT first_name, last_name FROM students WHERE student_id NOT IN (SELECT student_id FROM enrollments)

question: Which course has the most enrollments? Break ties alphabetically.
gold_sql: SELECT c.course_name FROM courses c JOIN enrollments e ON c.course_id = e.course_id GROUP BY c.course_id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, c.course_name LIMIT 1
